- PHI retention: our internal policy requires PHI to be retained no longer than 90 days unless explicitly approved by our legal team. Is that configurable per-tenant on your side?
- Audit trails: we need immutable, signed audit logs for at least 365 days with the ability to export for audits.
- Redaction: can Redwood guarantee that prompt/response pairs containing PHI can be redacted or excluded from logs (we may need selective redaction rules).

Looping in Jon (CISO) on technical and legal items. We'll need SOC2 and any encryption/KMS details to move forward with procurement.

Hi Laura / team —

Thanks for the clear questions. Summary of Redwood capabilities and suggested MAP language: 

1) Retention
- Per-tenant retention is configurable. Default for hosted customers is 30 days for request/response content.
- We can support a PHI-specific retention policy; options: 7 days (short), 30 days (default), 90 days (extended). Any retention longer than 30 days for PHI requires an approved exception and customer-managed keys (KMIP/HSM) to meet your policy.

2) Logging & audit trails
- We provide detailed audit logs (request timestamp, client IP, model id, request metadata, token counts).
- By default, request/response bodies are included in logs for troubleshooting; we support configurable redaction (regex-based) to remove PII/PHI fields from logged payloads.
- Immutable, signed audit logs: we can provide an append-only signed log export (SHA256-based signing) retained for 365 days. Exports can be generated as compressed, signed bundles and delivered via secure transfer (S3 presigned URLs or SFTP).

3) Encryption & keys
- At rest: AES-256 encryption by default. For PHI we recommend customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM) — Redwood supports using customer KMS to wrap model artifacts and persistent storage.
- In transit: TLS 1.2+ for all endpoints.

4) Operational constraints / dependencies for MAP
- DPA signed before any PHI processing.
- Region lock to US-only for PHI; cannot replicate to eu/apac unless approved.
- For the most restrictive PHI handling (short retention + customer KMS), we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private deployment. Hosted can be used with limitations.

Attachments: SOC2-SR-Report-2025.pdf (redacted)

Suggested MAP language (short): 
"Redwood to provide SOC2 artifacts, DPA, and implement per-tenant PHI retention and configurable redaction. Acme to provide PHI acceptance criteria, choose customer-managed KMS if PHI retention >30 days, and confirm region (US)."

If this looks good I can add the exact SLA/acceptance criteria to the MAP and provide a sample signed audit log for review.

-Neha Kapoor

Team —

This all looks good. We're comfortable moving forward with the following for the MAP: 

- PHI retention: 90 days (Acme will request exception from legal for >30 days; we prefer to set 90 days in the MAP for now).
- Audit logs: 365 days, signed export via S3 presigned URL. Full request/response bodies should be stored server-side but made available as an option (we'd like metadata + hashed payloads by default for daily operations; full bodies only for exportable audit bundles).
- DPA: we'll need the DPA and SOC2 artifact to start procurement; please send drafts ASAP.
- Target close date: 2026-04-15 is acceptable.

Please update the MAP with these specifics and re-send for final sign-off; once we have the DPA in hand we can route to legal and Jon for approval.

Thanks —
Laura
